gaps.what: The cession of Andorra to the Bishop of Urgell is dated 988 (Andorra page), 1133 (Ermengol VI page) and 'twelfth century' (County page); no loss is written and Cliopatria keeps the cell in Urgell to 1235
Steps of 1015, 1066, 1094, 1099, 1126, 1152, 1169, 1177, 1188, 1192 are vertex changes only; the cell added in 1111 is undated; no area on any page

The Crown of Aragon books Urgell in 1236 and the counts of Cabrera, Cardona and Aragon (1236-1413) hold a dependent title; the dossier gives the land to the Crown in 1231 (James I page) and keeps the state alive landless to 1413; the Peter of Portugal pages failed

Conflent, Alt Rosselló and inland Vallespir passed to the counts of Cerdanya 'late in the 10th century' (Roussillon page), against Conflent to Miró in 897 (Wilfred page) and Vallespir with Besalú in 988 (county-of-berga); no year or extent, Cliopatria keeps them in Roussillon, nothing taken out
Move of the capital from Castellrosselló to Perpignan has no year (placed at 989, confidence 1); no area for the county
No seat before the 1011 division (Sort is the undated 'chief city'); no area; the Ermengol I entry (992-1010) of the count list is unexplained
Brief annexations to the Crown of Aragon in 1396 and 1512 (years only), the second paréage of 1288 and the 1607 edict are not drawn; capital undated

problems: County of Urgell (870-1808) is two states: shapes 1279-1808 are the valleys of Andorra. New dossier co-principality-of-andorra (1278-1812, cliopatria_names 'County of Urgell') reviews them; it is the same state as principality-of-andorra (eu-20, Cliopatria 1815-2024, Wikidata Q228), broken by the annexation of 1812-1814. The orchestrator should merge them into one dossier for 1278 to today or give the colour agent one family. county-of-urgell and co-principality-of-andorra show 14 and 20 expected 'shape has no verdict' warnings because each reviews only its own half of the row.

county-of-urgell: kept alive 798-1413 although it has land of its own only 798-947 and 992-1230 (948-991 in union with Barcelona; from 1231 the Crown, James I page). Cliopatria's 878 and 896 shapes (62 and 63 cells) are Wilfred the Hairy's whole patrimony and were replaced by the 870 outline; west-franks books the 878 loss to county-of-urgell and should name county-of-barcelona and county-of-besalu.

Matching events needed elsewhere: crown-of-aragon (Urgell gain 1231 not 1236, vassal relation 1236-1413, loss of the Andorra cell 1278); taifa-of-lerida (losses to county-of-urgell 1050, 1076, 1091); almoravid-dynasty (losses 1105 Balaguer, 1149 a third of Lleida).

county-of-pallars ends 1011 and its 1010 shape is adjusted to 1011; county-of-pallars-jussa and county-of-pallars-sobira apply their 1040 shapes back to 1011, so the renderer should end Pallars in the year they are founded.

WebFetch returns paraphrase for part of every page; quoted fragments are the tool's. Two guessed URLs (Peter of Portugal) failed. Page budgets: Urgell 12 of 14, Pallars 4 of 5 (one thin), Roussillon 3 of 5.
